notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures
description:
Activate Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind.
Repeat.
